local_enable.description: Allow local (system) users to log in to the FTP server.

write_enable.description: Enable write operations (upload, delete, rename, etc.) for authenticated users.

anon_root.description: Absolute path to the root directory for anonymous users (chroot jail).

chroot_local_user.description: Restrict local users to their home directories (chroot jail).

chroot_list_enable.description: Enable the chroot user list file (see chroot_list_file). If set, only users *not* in the list will be chrooted (if chroot_local_user=YES).

chroot_list_file.description: Path to file listing users to exempt from chroot jail (if chroot_list_enable=YES and chroot_local_user=YES).

listen.description: Run vsftpd as a standalone daemon (not under inetd/xinetd).

listen_port.description: TCP port on which vsftpd listens for FTP control connections.

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 in addition to IPv4 (requires IPv6 support and listen=YES).

pasv_enable.description: Enable passive mode data connections (required for clients behind NAT/firewall).

pasv_min_port.description: Lowest port to use for passive mode data connections (firewall must allow inbound TCP to this range).

pasv_max_port.description: Highest port to use for passive mode data connections (firewall must allow inbound TCP to this range).

max_clients.description: Maximum total number of simultaneous client connections. 0 means unlimited.

max_per_ip.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections per client IP. 0 means unlimited.

idle_session_timeout.description: Time (seconds) before idle sessions are disconnected (0 = no timeout).

data_connection_timeout.description: Time (seconds) before idle data connections are closed (0 = no timeout).

ftpd_banner.description: Banner message displayed to users before authentication.

userlist_enable.description: Enable the user list file (userlist_file) to control access.

userlist_file.description: Path to file listing users allowed/denied access (see userlist_deny).

userlist_deny.description: If true, users in userlist_file are denied login. If false, only users in userlist_file are allowed.

ssl_enable.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption (FTPS). Requires valid certificate and key.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enable=YES.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if ssl_enable=YES.

ssl_ciphers.description: SSL/TLS cipher list to allow. Default is 'HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5'.

log_file.description: Path to vsftpd log file (used in init script only).
